intake.title: Intake policy
intake.description: Let niuniu pick up work automatically when rules allow. By default it only observes.
intake.emptyDescription: Once sources are configured, this page will show their modes, rules and pending calibration.
intake.pauseHint: Stops inferred and automatic intake. Explicit requests keep working.
intake.summary: Up to {{cap}} per day · {{rules}} rules · {{members}} allowed members
intake.calibrationHint: Observe at least 10 decisions before enabling auto.
intake.saveSuccess: Policy saved. It applies to the next event.
intake.saveInvalid: Fix the highlighted fields before saving.
intake.autoNoRules: Auto mode needs at least one enabled rule, otherwise inferred work is not accepted: {{sources}}
intake.connectComingSoon: Connecting this source is not available yet.
intake.pausePausedToast: Intake paused. Inferred and automatic intake stopped; explicit requests still work.
intake.unsavedLeaveDescription: Those changes will be lost if you leave. Leave anyway?

rules.saved: Rule saved. It applies to the next event.
rules.name: Name
rules.instructionPlaceholder: Describe what this kind of work means in this project
rules.instructionHint: Rules only describe which work may be accepted; they never grant more than the allow list.
rules.actorsHint: The rule only matches messages sent by these external accounts.
rules.keywordsHint: The rule matches when any keyword appears. CJK matches by substring; Latin matches on word sequences.
rules.requiredCondition: Add at least one actor or one keyword.
rules.deleteConfirm: Delete rule “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone.

dialog.description: Rules decide which inferred work may be accepted for this source's mode.

config.title: Configure {{source}}
config.description: Adjust the allow list, rules, daily cap and policy history. Changes apply when you press Save on the panel.
config.allowListHint: Only listed people may explicitly start work; empty keeps the source's own admission boundary.
config.botListHint: Bots may only produce inferred work; they can never stop a task or trigger a high-risk action.
config.rulesEmpty: Without a rule, auto mode will not accept inferred work.
config.githubEventsHint: Choose which events from this repository enter the intake pipeline. Polling is outbound only, so no public URL is needed.
config.githubNoRepos: No GitHub repository is bound yet. Bind a repository and credential under External sources first.
config.dailyCapHint: Maximum automatic pickups per day; 0 = none, default 4.
config.dailyCapError: Enter an integer of 0 or more.
config.policyVersionHint: Every settings or rule save creates a new version.

history.title: Policy version history
history.description: Each version records the settings and rules at that time; select one to see its diff from the previous version.
history.empty: No policy versions yet. They are created after the first settings save.

mode.label: Mode
mode.offDescription: Only respond when niuniu is explicitly addressed.
mode.observeDescription: Record work it would pick up, without acting.
mode.autoDescription: Accept work within rules and the daily cap.

calibration.readyHint: You've reached the threshold for turning on auto.
calibration.needCount: {{count}} more calibrated decisions before auto can be suggested.
calibration.needRate: Acceptance rate is under {{rate}}%; keep calibrating or adjust the rules.

dialog.title: Enable auto intake
dialog.description: Selected sources will accept matching inferred work on their own, within their rules and daily cap. You can pause at any time, and resuming needs no re-calibration.
dialog.sourceDetail: Daily cap {{cap}} · {{rules}} enabled rules · {{members}} allowed members
dialog.allowListEmpty: Allow list empty: the source's own admission boundary applies.
dialog.noRules: No enabled rule: inferred work will not be accepted.
dialog.zeroCap: Daily cap is 0: nothing will be accepted automatically.
dialog.pauseNote: Pause intake at any time in settings or on Mission control. Resuming keeps these modes and the calibration.
dialog.settingsUnavailable: Intake settings are unavailable, so auto cannot be enabled right now.
dialog.enabledToast: Auto intake enabled. Pause any time; resuming needs no re-calibration.
dialog.settingsMissing: Source settings are unavailable; their allow list and cap can't be shown.

calibration.activeHint: Auto is on for the calibrated sources. You can pause any time; resuming needs no re-calibration.

intake.autoNeedsCalibration: Auto is selected for {{sources}}, but the calibration sample is still below the threshold ({{calibrated}}/{{min}} decisions, {{rate}}% accepted). The setting will apply, but consider observing longer first.

completion.title: Completion policy
completion.description: Controls how far a task is pushed, and when it stops to ask a person.
completion.autohostHint: When off, every turn ends back in the pending column.
completion.stopOnDecision: Stop and ask when a decision is needed
completion.stopOnDecisionShort: Stops when a decision is needed
completion.invalidRounds: Enter a whole number of 0 or more.
completion.invalidBudget: Enter a whole number of 0 or more.
completion.budgetWarning: A zero budget with a high round count can make long tasks expensive.
completion.saved: Saved. Applies to the next turn.
completion.profilesHint: Issues can pick a named profile; an issue without one uses the project default.
completion.profileDialogDescription: Named profiles override the project default for the issues that select them. Fields are never merged.
completion.profileSaved: Profile saved. It applies to the next turn.
completion.deleteInUse: {{count}} issue(s) still use this profile. Switch them back to inherit or to another profile first.
completion.deleteInUseBlocked: This profile is still assigned to issues. Switch them back to inherit or to another profile first.
completion.issueHint: Pick a named profile to override the project default, or inherit it.

missionControl.completionSubtitle: How tasks are pushed to done

review.title: Needs calibration
review.description: Work niuniu recorded while observing. Nothing is created until you accept it.
review.emptyDescription: With observe mode on, work niuniu would have picked up shows up here.
review.emptyIgnoredDescription: Ignored decisions stay here so you can review the call later.
review.noProjectDescription: Create a project and connect a source; decisions will appear here.
review.selectPrompt: Select a decision to see its details
review.rulesLoadFailed: Rule names unavailable; rule ids are still shown
review.policyVersionHint: The policy version in force when this decision was made.
review.acceptancePlaceholder: e.g. add a regression test after the fix
review.suggestCliUnavailable: The local CLI is unavailable, so no suggestion can be generated
review.suggestRateLimited: Too many requests, try again shortly
review.acceptFailed: Accept failed; your edits were kept
review.ignoreDescription: Choose a reason. An ignored decision leaves the calibration queue.
review.ignoreBatchDescription: Choose a reason for all selected decisions.
review.acceptedButDeliveryFailed: Task recorded, but the message was not delivered to its agent: {{message}}
review.emptyHistoryDescription: Accepted and ignored suggestions will appear here.
